backup_dirs.description: List of directories to back up. Each path must exist and be readable.

hostname.description: Hostname used to identify this machine in backup filenames.

tarball_date_format.description: Date format used for tarball filename suffixes (e.g., %Y-%m-%d for YYYY-MM-DD).

compression_level.description: Compression level (1–9). Higher = more compression, slower.

repository_root.description: Base directory where backups are stored locally.

repository_subdir.description: Subdirectory under repository_root for this tool's backups.

use_tar_prefix.description: Prefix tar archives with hostname and date (e.g., hostname-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz).

delete_after_backup.description: Delete local tarball immediately after successful remote sync (for space-constrained systems).

oldest_file_days.description: Remove local backups older than N days (0 = disable aging).

max_backup_days.description: Remove remote backups older than N days (0 = disable aging).

use_rsync.description: Enable rsync-based remote backups (requires valid SSH access).

rsync_host.description: Remote host for rsync backup destination.

rsync_user.description: User account used for rsync over SSH.

rsync_port.description: SSH port for remote rsync connection.

rsync_path.description: Absolute path on remote host where backups are stored.

rsync_options.description: Additional rsync options (space-separated in config, provided as list).

export_databases.description: Enable database dump + backup (supports MySQL, PostgreSQL).

databases.description: List of databases to dump and include in backup.

password.description: Database password. If empty, tool tries ~/.my.cnf or .pgpass.

name.description: Database name to dump. Use '*' to dump all databases.

port.description: Port (default: 3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL). Set to null for default.

file.description: Filename for the database dump (relative to temp dir).

ssh_key.description: Path to private SSH key used for rsync or database remote access.

ssh_options.description: Additional SSH options (space-separated in config, list here).

mail_alert.description: Send email alert on backup success/failure.

mail_subject_prefix.description: Prefix added to alert email subject line.

pre_backup_hook.description: Absolute path to script to run before backup (e.g., to freeze filesystem or stop services).

post_backup_hook.description: Absolute path to script to run after backup (e.g., cleanup, notification, or upload).
